gates.evidence: Site climate design, season/day/evening duty, humidity, solar, passengers, door cycle and ventilation/filtration criteria. Current110/75°F cooling and30/68°F heating are probes.
Actual HVAC and auxiliary nameplates, cold/hot output, input/PF/start curve, fan pressure and sensible/latent/net-fan capacity conventions; heat locations and charger energy balance.
32coach chambers plus loco/lines/valves; accepted free-air demand, leakage, recharges, duty, compressor shaft/electrical/start loads. Explicitly allocate compressor to one supply path.
Roof/underframe support, loaded CG, headroom, drains, vibration, fire/smoke/materials, return/supply separation, outside intake/exhaust separation, service and swept clearance.

Chosen generator/distribution topology, fault/short-circuit and voltage-drop study, bonding/grounding and neutral regime, moving connections, isolation/interlocks, emergency illumination and selected cold/aged battery acceptance.

test_evidence: Measure HVAC input, start transient, minimum terminal voltage and generator recovery under selected simultaneous loads. Acceptance values by responsible engineers.
Verify supply/outside airflow at dirty-filter pressure, temperatures/humidity, duct leakage and occupied comfort; no recirculation fan counted as fresh air without a real outside-air path.
Measure charger/DC load and thermal locations at operating/recharge/reserve conditions; verify brownout and controlled restart without brake/egress impairment.
Instrument compressor recovery, brake release/application timing and repeated-stop duty on accepted full trainline; catalog volume sums alone cannot qualify it.
Inspect bonding, isolation, connectors, condensate routing and exhaust reingestion in both travel directions; qualified specialists own energized and safety tests.

next.scope: Complete current HVAC physical installation comparison from exact manuals; verify ADB/headroom, roof openings, manufacturer service envelopes and ventilation interface. If controlled interfaces unavailable, advance3Q track/station survey-and-construction coordination and operations/authority evidence, keeping open gates consolidated.
